name: codex
description: OpenAI Codex CLI in non-interactive mode (`codex exec`). Policies vary how many tools are exposed: `curated` ignores the operator's config so only Codex's built-ins are present, while `full` loads it and inherits every configured MCP server and plugin.
verificationNote: Verified against a live install (codex-cli 0.147.0, authenticated via ChatGPT). `codex exec --ignore-user-config --sandbox read-only --skip-git-repo-check "<prompt>"` returns the answer as plain stdout, so output.type is "text" -- no JSON or JSONL parsing involved. IMPORTANT, a correction: an earlier version of this profile mapped curated/full to --sandbox read-only vs workspace-write. That varies write permission, not the number of exposed tools, so it was the wrong variable for claim 001. The sandbox is now fixed at read-only in extraArgs for both arms, and the policy axis is --ignore-user-config, which is what actually changes how many tools the model sees. THE SIZE OF THAT CONTRAST DEPENDS ON THE OPERATOR: on a machine with no MCP servers configured, curated and full are identical and the comparison is vacuous. Record how many servers/plugins your config loads when reporting a result from this profile. NOT captured: cost and token counts, which Codex reports only on its --json event stream.
